skills.name: Frostbite
skills.text: Deals damage equal to [ATK * 180%] and inflicts [Damage Taken Up + 35%] to all enemies. Additionally, grants self [Crit Rate +50%] for 3 turns
skills.sourceText: Deals damage equal to [ATK * 180%] and inflicts [Damage Taken Up + 35%] to all enemies. Additionally, grants self [Crit Rate +50%] for 3 turns

skills.name: Chivalry
skills.text: Restores HP equal to [ATK * 400%] to the ally with the lowest HP and increases their [Crit Rate +30%] for 3 turns.
skills.sourceText: Restores HP equal to [ATK * 400%] to the ally with the lowest HP and increases their [Crit Rate +30%] for 3 turns.

skills.name: Entangling Strike
skills.text: Deals damage equal to [ATK * 450%] to the enemy with the lowest HP and decreases the enemy's [CRIT RES -30%] for 3 turns.
skills.sourceText: Deals damage equal to [ATK * 450%] to the enemy with the lowest HP and decreases the enemy's [CRIT RES -30%] for 3 turns.

skills.name: Ice Feather Armor
skills.text: Shields the 2 highest-Attack allies for 350% of caster Attack and grants them +40 percentage points of critical chance for 3 turns.
skills.sourceText: Grants shields that absorb damage up to [ATK * 350%] to the 2 highest-ATK allies and increases their [Crit Rate +40%] for 2 turns.

skills.name: Meteor Blessing
skills.text: Deals [ATK*300%] damage to 2 random enemies in the back row, and increases own [CRIT Rate by 40%] for 3 turns.
skills.sourceText: Deals [ATK*300%] damage to 2 random enemies in the back row, and increases own [CRIT Rate by 40%] for 3 turns.

skills.name: Pointed Guardian
skills.text: Grants a shield to all front-row allies, absorbing up to [ATK*250%] damage and increasing their [Crit Resistance by 30%] for 3 turns.
skills.sourceText: Grants a shield to all front-row allies, absorbing up to [ATK*250%] damage and increasing their [Crit Resistance by 30%] for 3 turns.

skills.name: Fiery Grilled
skills.text: Deals [ATK*450%] damage to a random enemy in the back row, and reduces their [Crit by 30%] for 3 turns.
skills.sourceText: Deals [ATK*450%] damage to a random enemy in the back row, and reduces their [Crit by 30%] for 3 turns.

skills.name: Clang Crystal
skills.text: Deals 270% Attack damage to up to 2 front-row enemies and reduces their critical resistance by 40 percentage points for 3 turns.
skills.sourceText: Deals [ATK*270%] damage to all front row enemies and reduces their [Crit Resistance] by 40% for 3 turns.
